title: Steam & Fire
description: Modpack that combines mods such as Create, Create Aeronautics, Ice And Fire, Farmer's Delight to create a adventure for both the builders and the explorers.
body:
# Steam & Fire

## About
Steam & Fire combines mods to make a pleasant experience for both builders and explorers. 

This modpack intend to provide a nice experience for different types of players while trying to stick to a medieval + steampunk fantasy setting. 

## Main Features
[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)

[Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics)

[Ice And Fire](https://modrinth.com/mod/iceandfire-ce)

[Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)

[Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](https://modrinth.com/mod/irons-spells-n-spellbooks)
